create_hook_registry: create a HookRegistry to manage hooks on a PyTorch module
register_model_hook: register a ModelHook with a HookRegistry to intercept forward passes
remove_hook_from_registry: remove a named hook from a HookRegistry and restore the original forward
manage_stateful_hooks: reset stateful hooks across a module tree using StateManager and reset_stateful_hooks
set_hook_context: set a context name across all stateful hooks and child registries in a HookRegistry
